info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Update Product Broker Agreement API
info.description: This API facilitates the modification of existing product broker agreements, ensuring that terms and details remain relevant and up-to-date. By leveraging this endpoint, organizations can efficiently manage their agreements with external agencies, maintaining compliance with changing regulations and business needs. Typical consumers include financial institutions and partners looking to adjust the specifics of their broker relationships. The API supports seamless updates to agreement parameters, fostering better collaboration and alignment in service delivery.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of the specified Product Broker Agreement in the external agency system, ensuring that all relevant information is accurately reflected and maintained.

requestBody.description: This request body allows clients to update the product broker agreement for a specific external agency identified by PROD-700045. The provided JSON data must conform to the specified schema and include the necessary fields for the update operation.

200.description: The request was successful and the resource has been updated.
